chunks: Yet they are surely mischief-mongers, even though they do not know.
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers think they are righteous while being corrupt?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual blindness of the disbelievers who, despite claiming righteousness, are the true agents of corruption (mufsidun) in the earth. Their lack of awareness (la yash'urun) signifies a deeper cognitive dissonance where they fail to recognize their own destructive impact on both society and their own souls. This concept underscores the Shia emphasis on self-reflection (muhasabah) to distinguish between superficial piety and genuine spiritual integrity.
